description: Free car tools and open data for driving in Germany, by Spiking Labs. Every tool is a static page whose inputs live in the URL.

tools.name: ev_charging_cost
tools.title: EV charging cost per 100 km
tools.description: Cost per 100 km of an electric car at any price per kWh, and the break-even electricity price against Germany's most registered petrol and diesel cars (or your own fuel car).

tools.name: charging_price_archive
tools.title: Charging price archive
tools.description: Ad-hoc public charging prices in Germany collected every hour: median, 10th and 90th percentile per day and per source.

tools.name: car_recalls
tools.title: Car recalls
tools.description: Official recalls per car model and brand: EU Safety Gate motor vehicle alerts since 2019 (Germany's KBA reports every German vehicle recall there) and US NHTSA campaigns for the same models. Updated daily. Open a model with ?model=<slug>, a brand with ?brand=<slug>.
